scope.description: Direct AMDHSA code-object metadata for every Q4_RDNA kernel instance embedded in q4rdna_splitk_bench.

device_topology_context.hip_multiprocessor_count_reporting_unit: WGP (Work Group Processor) on this gfx1201 HIP stack
device_topology_context.interpretation: Do not call both values compute units: rocminfo reports 64 physical Compute Units, while hipGetDeviceProperties().multiProcessorCount reports 32 WGPs.

hip_multiprocessor_count.meaning: WGP count reported by HIP for this gfx1201 device/stack

device_topology_counts.warning: 64 physical Compute Units and 32 HIP-reported WGPs are different counting units and must not be labeled interchangeably.

unavailable_or_not_reliably_derivable.reason: No required-workgroup-size field is present in the AMDHSA metadata for these kernels.
Launch size is a runtime call-site property; the code object reports only max_flat_workgroup_size here.
No fixed X/Y/Z workgroup dimensions are encoded in the reported AMDHSA metadata.
The metadata directly reports only group_segment_fixed_size; no per-launch dynamic LDS amount is encoded here.
The code-object argument records contain offset, size, value kind and address space but no argument names/source type names.
Not reported by the code object and not inferred from register/LDS counts alone.
